title: Photothermal-responsive self-healing PDMS-based elastomers for stretchable strain sensors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18270-18281
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01474G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruijie Zhu, Ling Ai, Zhou Zhou, Jie Gao, Yuanlong Zhong, Qi Zhang, Weijie Song
A photothermal responsive self-healing PDMS-based elastomer was constructed by the incorporation of epoxy unit and disulfide bond, exhibiting favorable toughness and self-healing efficiency, and showing potential application in stretchable strain sensors.
